reuse.why: Calls the shared link.assertBankAccountNotLinked and link.findOrCreateBank, but copies the rest of the link flow and the downloader from the Akahu provider instead of extracting a shared link/download routine.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount repeats the ~60-line upgrade-or-create/payee/sync/notify body of linkAkahuAccount, downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions, and fintegraAccounts copies akahuAccounts.

placement.why: Each piece lands in the module where the tree keeps the matching code for other providers (accounts/app.ts, sync.ts, server-config.ts, types/models).

scope.why: Adds an unrequested fintegra-accounts listing handler on top of the requested server-side link and sync.

maintainability.why: A sixth hand-copied provider pipeline means any future change to linking or downloading must be repeated in yet another place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the tree's existing shared assertBankAccountNotLinked and findOrCreateBank; the copied flow follows the tree's existing per-provider copy pattern rather than going around a shared helper

disguised_duplication.where: The copies (link body, downloader, accounts listing) are near-verbatim with provider names swapped
